description:
A versatile mind mapping tool for collaborative brainstorming.

EdrawMind is designed for creating fresh new visual innovations, integrating your bullet points to structure an overall mind map. It is convenient and helpful for you to use EdrawMind to sort out your thoughts or ideas in order to find solutions to problems.
AI Export: Turn Mind Maps into Narrated Videos with One Click
Access Point: Open a mind map, click Export in the top-right corner, and select AI-narrated Video.
One-Click Generation: Simply select a style and click generate to transform your mind map into an engaging, narrated video.
Voice Customization: The AI intelligently parses your map’s hierarchy and text to generate smooth shot transitions and natural voiceovers, with multiple voice tones available.
Try it now to experience a whole new way of presenting knowledge!
AI Export: Infographic & Knowledge Card
Access Point: Open a mind map, click Export in the top-right corner, and select Infographic / Knowledge Card.
Say goodbye to tedious formatting—convert structured mind maps into sleek, professional infographic posters and knowledge cards with a single click.
Multiple preset styles available to instantly deliver designer-grade visual assets.
AI Export: Hand-Drawn Mind Maps
The export interface has been upgraded with a new AI Export option, allowing you to instantly transform standard mind maps into hand-drawn styles.
Access Point: After editing your map, go to Export > AI Export > Hand-Drawn Mind Map in the top-right corner.
Option 1 (Editable Format): Converts your map into a native hand-drawn file, ideal for further customization and editing.
Option 2 (Image Generation): Uses advanced image models to generate a polished hand-drawn visual, ready for immediate sharing.
